cases.rationale: A balanced reassociation was proven equivalent. It reduced the word-level RTLIL path from 3 to 2 cells with the same three adders, but the pinned generic Yosys/ABC synthesis produced exactly the same 107 gates and 15-cell longest path for baseline and candidate. The mapped flow already handles the association, so there is no established balanced-PPA gain.
limitations: The generic gate library is a relative comparison, not a characterized target technology.
